name: Cabrizzio
source:
Stylish and fit, a little rebellious with a charm all his own and that killer smile, Cabrizzio is naturally flirtatious and often gets mistaken for a playboy, but that's not his game. He's here to enjoy existence with a laissez-faire approach. We live and laugh, and revel in the good moments we have with each other. Sometimes he'll display a depth to him rooted in tradition and family. And if you don't hold on to those handles firmly, he might just sweep you off your feet.
Likes: Italy, Imagination, Romance 
Dislikes: Urgency, Reality, France

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
